front.title: CBOR Tag for PromiseGrid Protocol Messages

abstract.t: This document defines a Concise Binary Object Representation (CBOR) tag for identifying messages conforming to the PromiseGrid wire protocol. The tag serves as a wrapper that enables receiving systems to recognize and properly interpret PromiseGrid protocol messages. The PromiseGrid protocol is a decentralized, agent-based system designed for structured message exchange with versioning through IPFS Content Identifiers (CIDs).
